2609.04647.title: CAGE: Coherence-Aware Graph Encoding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2609.04647.paper_summary: Traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems score each passage independently against the query, assembling context sets that may be individually relevant yet collectively incoherent. We introduce Coherence-Aware Graph Encoding (CAGE), a reranking framework that models "between-chunk coherence" across four dimensions: Intra-Domain Relevance, Noise Resistance, Informational Bonding, and Factual Consistency. Our pipeline transforms retrieved passages into directed heterogeneous entity graphs, amplifies factual anchors via min-out-degree reweighting, encodes structural patterns through a Relational Graph Convolutional Network, and fuses inter-chunk coherence with query relevance for final ranking. Evaluated across four multi-hop benchmarks, CAGE matches or outperforms strong baselines including monoT5 in Recall@5 on bridge-dominated datasets and consistently improves downstream Exact Match, demonstrating that structurally coherent context yields more precise answers even when retrieval recall is comparable or lower.
2609.04647.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的檢索增強生成 (RAG) 系統獨立地對每個段落進行打分，組裝出可能各自相關但整體上不一致的上下文集。我們提出了關聯性意識圖編碼 (CAGE)，這是一個重新排序框架，通過四個維度建模「片段之間的一致性」：域內相關性、噪聲抵抗、信息聯結和事實一致性。我們的流程將檢索到的段落轉換為有向異質實體圖，通過最小出度重加權來放大事實錨點，通過關係圖卷積網絡編碼結構模式，並將片段之間的一致性與查詢相關性融合以進行最終排序。在四個多跳基準測試中評估，CAGE 在以橋接為主的數據集上與 monoT5 在 Recall@5 的強基準相匹配或超越，並持續改善下游的精確匹配，顯示出結構一致的上下文即使在檢索回憶相當或較低的情況下也能產生更精確的答案。
